title: Application of Boston Edison Company for (i) approval of certain investments and commitments relating to Harbor Electric Energy Company, (ii) approval of the par value share of the common stock of Harbor Electric Energy Company and the issuance of 1,000 shares of common stock, par value $1.00 of Harbor Electric Energy Company, and (iii) an amendment to the Order issued by the Department in each of D.P.U. 89-150 and 89-31.
